readme_excerpt: Simple Icons Over 3400 SVG icons for popular brands. See them all on one page at SimpleIcons.org . Contributions, corrections & requests can be made on GitHub. Usage > [!IMPORTANT]\ > We ask that all users read our legal disclaimer before using icons from Simple Icons. General Usage Icons can be downloaded as SVGs directly from simpleicons.org - simply click the download button of the icon you want, and the download will start automatically.
